sources.snippet: Moonshine Tiny (27M) for dysarthric speech: SFT + RL (SAPC2) Fine-tuned for the Speech Accessibility Project Challenge 2 (SAPC2): English speech from speakers with ALS, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, Parkinson's disease and stroke.

sources.snippet: Moonshine m10s (10.8M): width 256, 7 heads, distilled from m15s (SAPC2) Fine-tuned for the Speech Accessibility Project Challenge 2 (SAPC2): English speech from speakers with ALS, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, Parkinson's disease and stroke.
